prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic respectful portrait of an approved adult Muslim woman inside a mosque holding tasbih.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult Muslim woman with natural hazel eyes, visible realistic skin texture, bareface natural look, soft subtle smile, and calm peaceful expression. She wears an elegant black modest outfit and neatly framed black hijab, a delicate gold flower-charm bracelet, and gently holds prayer beads in one hand.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 close-up upper-body portrait, face and tasbih sharp, softly blurred mosque architecture and worshippers in the background, graceful modest posture, authentic spiritual atmosphere.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Camera flash balanced with soft ambient mosque light, natural highlights, gentle cinematic shadows, peaceful Ramadan/Tarawih atmosphere, respectful non-intrusive framing of worshippers.
prompt.technical_specs: Latest-smartphone-style photorealism, sharp face and hands, shallow depth, realistic black fabric and prayer beads, no beauty smoothing, subtle grain, no watermark or text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic respectful 9:16 close-up portrait of an approved adult Muslim woman standing inside a mosque. She has natural hazel eyes, visible realistic skin texture, a bareface natural look, soft subtle smile, and calm peaceful expression. She wears an elegant black modest outfit and a neatly framed black hijab, a delicate gold flower-charm bracelet, and gently holds tasbih prayer beads in one hand. Keep the face and beads sharp while softly blurring mosque architecture and worshippers in the background. Use smartphone-style flash balanced with soft ambient mosque light, natural skin highlights, gentle cinematic shadows, realistic black fabric and beads, peaceful Ramadan/Tarawih atmosphere, and respectful non-intrusive framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, disrespectful religious imagery, distorted face, deformed hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, logo

assets.name: approved-adult-muslimah-subject
assets.usage: Preserve the adult face, hijab, expression, modest styling, and identity with cultural respect.

assets.name: tasbih-and-gold-flower-bracelet
assets.usage: Keep prayer beads, hand placement, bracelet, and respectful usage consistent; replace only with explicit alternatives.

assets.name: mosque-interior-worship-space
assets.usage: Maintain mosque architecture, spiritual atmosphere, and softly blurred worshippers; replace only with an explicit location reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach person, accessory, and location references when exact consistency is required. Keep adult identity, modest outfit, hijab, tasbih, religious context, and respectful environment consistent. Background worshippers may be replaced only with explicit alternatives; preserve identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, and typography.
